description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Shinsect Riot Style, Riot Battery, Base Attack Bonus +5

Benefit: When you use Forceful Strike and deal non-lethal damage to your opponent, you can increase the DC by 1 for every 5 points of non-lethal damage dealt. In addition, should the opponent fail the DC of their save by 5 or more, they are stunned instead of staggered.

system.requirements: Shinsect Riot Style, Riot Battery, Base Attack Bonus +5
